text: Harbour City führte nach einer klugen Kombination mit 2:0, dank Elias Okafor und Marek Barros, der ein starkes Spiel ablieferte und sogar das erste Tor aus knapp 28 Metern mit extrem geringer Trefferwahrscheinlichkeit (xG 0,029) erzielte [#905] [#975]. Doch Seabrook Town ließ sich nicht unterkriegen und war mit 22 Schüssen deutlich aktiver als Harbour City (10 Schüsse) und erarbeitete sich einen erwarteten Torwert (xG) von 3,53 – das heißt, sie hatten viele gute Chancen. Die Wende kam ab der 65. Minute, als Seabrook mit mehr Druck und direkteren Bällen spielte, was Callum Varga ein Tor erlaubte [#1361] [#1448]. In der Nachspielzeit erzielte Kian Romano sogar zwei Tore mit sehr hohen Chancenwerten (xG 0,554 und 0,994) und sicherte Seabrook den Sieg mit 4:2 [#1882] [#1906]. Harbour City versuchte noch eine späte Pressing-Offensive, aber Seabrook war zu stark auf Konter eingestellt [#1884].

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in de

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 despite trailing 2-0 early in the second half [#905, #975, #1104].
- Marek Barros scored for Harbour City with a very low xG of 0.029 and was Player of the Match with a rating of 10.0 [#975].
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time with high xG values of 0.554 and 0.994, turning the match in Seabrook Town’s favor [#1882, #1906].
- Seabrook Town had 22 shots and an xG of 3.53, significantly higher than Harbour City's 10 shots and 1.26 xG [team_stats].
- A red card to Joon Whitfield at 43’ may have impacted Harbour City's defensive capacity before conceding goals [#871].

- Harbour City’s early goal at 45' came from a lengthy patient build-up involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and style of patient short passing. The goal was finished by Elias Okafor following a through ball assist by playmaker Marek Barros, emphasizing their methodical possession approach [#904,905].
- Marek Barros’s second goal at 47' originated from a corner set piece, where a quick cross was delivered—showing Harbour City’s ability to capitalize on set pieces even though their style focuses on short passing, leveraging their crosses effectively from wide or dead-ball situations [#973,975].
- Seabrook Town’s first goal at 53' came immediately after a ball regain by Tariq Marlowe with a quick, direct finish, indicating a more direct attacking pattern from turnovers fitting their 3-4-3 formation and style of wide crossing play, exploiting quick transitions into attack [#1103,1104].
- After tactical changes at 65', Seabrook Town increased their press intensity and direct play, pushing their defensive line higher and allowing more frequent counter-attacks. This adjustment led to Callum Varga scoring from a through ball after regaining possession, illustrating how their pressing trap and directness complemented their wide crossing style while chasing the game [#1361,1447,1448].
- In the final minutes (90+2'), Seabrook’s goals from Kian Romano stemmed from quick counter-attacks and open play sequences following turnovers, exploiting Harbour City’s more patient build-up approach which faltered under increasing pressing and more direct threat from Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 setup focused on quick wide attacks and crossing [#1881,1882,1905,1906].
- Harbour City responded late by increasing their press and line height as a tactical change to chase the game, moving slightly towards a more direct play, but this left them vulnerable to Seabrook’s effective wide play and quick counters which ultimately decided the match [#1884].
